featured_reviews.name: kapish bhagnani
featured_reviews.review_text:
I took one year membership and i hardly went to the gym.

Before my wedding i took personal training.

During one of the sessions, one other trainer threw a bench at us, it hit both me as well my trainer. I was in shock as i had never even seen that person earlier maybe the trainers had some rivalry or something i still have no clue.

I went to the gym management immediately and they did nothing and i was hit, i was lucky it hit my leg but it could have been my head as earlier i was lying down and doing another variation and i had my wedding in 15 days.

I kept insisting them to take action but they did nothing i waited for almost an hour after my workout was disturbed then finally i had to call the police on 100 and the cops came and took both me and the trainer who assaulted me  in a van, i had never sat in one in my life, and my trainer also came later to give his side of the story as even he was hit by the bench, even on the way the other trainer abused a lot and threatened with dire consequences, they sent me for medical at baba hospital and then i submitted everything and left but no action was taken as the cop said the gym owner is an influential person.

No one from the gym management did anything they even told the cops it’s another trainer who did it and they can’t be held responsible for it hence no complaint can be filed against them.

I had 6 months of my membership left but it didn’t feel like it’s a safe place because management did nothing they didn’t even provide the footage of the person throwing the bench even when there is a cctv in the gym and he kept abusing me and laughing when ever i went to the gym after this happened, i was a paying customer at the gym and he was just a trainer and management did nothing.

After I complained, when ever i went to the gym the valet handed me over the keys never got the car back to gate and one of the time the car tyres were flat that’s when i decided on leaving the gym and i had to discontinue the personal training also.

The gym was really good and equipment is good also and they have everything you need except a 45Degree leg press, good crowd, there is valet parking service as well, it’s also the most VFM gym in the area, building is really bad in terms of cleanliness, there are cockroaches everywhere because there are lot of eateries, gym was super clean though but what happened came as a shock to me and i never went back even for a single day even though i had 6 months remaining on my membership subscription because safety was an issue, what if the guy hit the bench on my head while i was working out while lying down how would i protect myself, so you can imagine the trauma and no one goes to the gym to fight, in-fact i am always running short on time so I don’t even interact much i just leave as soon as i am done. Those days i was preparing for my wedding so i had 1000 things to do and they troubled me at that time so you can imagine what’s the mentality of the gym managment.

For me to go to the police station and then medical examination at baba hospital was like trauma because ideally the managment should have taken action, instead of compelling me to call the cops and my whole day was wasted i had to skip my clothes trial fitting appoint that day i remember and you also get unnecessarily stressed.

When i had joined the gym they made me read a lengthy document on gym rules but their trainer didn’t follow the same and they did nothing at all.

I am paying exactly double the amount per person  i paid at 360 but i am at peace when i work out at the current gym, there is no security concern or threat.

my personal trainer was outstanding he made me achieve my goal of looking fit for my wedding in less than a month i could have gotten better as this incident spoiled our momentum and discontinued, he even came to the police station with me and narrated the truth to them.

So if anything happens in the gym, management will do nothing they will shrug off any responsibility or accountability so please keep this in mind before joining.
